title: 第21章 如果你想玩角色扮演我乐意至极第22章 不讲武德在刀上抹药
slug: 救了元婴宗主夫人醒后她急了

听着她那带着羞愤的控诉，陆长生喉间终是溢出一阵低哑的闷笑。胸腔的震动打破了两人间凝滞的空气，连带着周遭幽暗的氛围也染上了几分灼人的温度。
柳师师单薄的脊背止不住地发僵。她本以为这逆徒又要如往日那般乘虚而入，下意识地蜷缩起如惊弓之鸟般的身躯。
陆长生没有顺势攻城略地，反而微微倾身，双臂带着一种不容置喙却又极尽克制的耐性，绕过她的身侧，将她肩头那半褪的衣襟一点点拉拢。
密室深处冷寂无声，唯有墙壁上嵌着的灵石灯芯偶尔爆开一星幽蓝的焰花，发出微弱的哔剥响动。
淡淡的苦涩药香与她身上特有的冷梅气息交织缠绕，在逼仄的空间里被无限放大。柳师师的呼吸急促且紊乱，而拂过她耳廓的男息，却深沉、绵长，滚烫得吓人。
他指腹带着练剑留下的粗粝薄茧，若有似无地擦过她精致的锁骨。
昨夜荒唐留下的深浅红痕依稀可辨，落在她如今这副病态的躯体上，显出一种近乎惨烈的破碎感。
陆长生的动作在那些靡丽的印记上微不可察地滞了滞，粗糙的指端带起一抹极为隐秘的怜惜，轻轻摩挲而过。
这抽丝剥茧般的轻柔，远比狂风骤雨的掠夺更令人毛骨悚然。柳师师只觉那指尖掠过之处，宛如被烙铁寸寸点燃，灼烧的战栗感顺着脆弱的经脉一路燎原，烧得她心尖发着颤。
既然师尊将徒儿的心思揣度得这般通透，连那些见不得光的腌臜念头都算计在内，倒真是徒儿的福分。
不过……他语调微顿，微凉的唇瓣贴着她颈侧最敏感的娇肤若即若离地掠过，滚烫的吐息如同一把软刷子扫在心头。“并不是现在。我方才按着你，不让你褪衣裳，还真不是师尊以为的那种龌龊心思。”
他极轻地嗤笑了一声，尾音带着一丝刻意的玩味。
"是你，想多了。"
这轻飘飘的三个字，犹如一颗石子砸进死水微澜的深潭。柳师师彻底僵在榻上，那双素来清冷傲世的桃花眼中，此刻骤然失去了焦距，错愕与茫然交织着化作一层朦胧的水汽。
她近乎呆滞地靠在褥子间，仿佛被抽去了浑身的骨架，只能任凭脱力的身子深陷进柔软的锦被里。
她无法置信地看着眼前这个一反常态的男人。
可如今，这个暴戾的逆徒却低垂着深邃多情的眉眼，无比细致、甚至称得上顶礼膜拜地为她整理衣衫。
他修长的十指灵巧地穿插，将那根险些被她赌气扯断的丝带重新束好，系成一个严丝合缝的结。
这种令人猝不及防的反差，比他癫狂时的强取豪夺还要致命。她早已习惯了用冰冷的面具去承受他的强势倾轧，如今这不期而遇的怜悯，反而化成了一把杀人不见血的软刀，正一寸寸地剔开她用来维持尊严的坚硬外壳。

那你……到底想做什么？她的嘴唇干涩得发白，嗫嚅着吐出细碎的字句。连她自己都没察觉，往日里高高在上、习惯了厉声训诫的语气，此刻竟染上了连她都羞于面对的惶恐。
直到抹平了最后一道衣褶，陆长生才缓缓直起腰。他那张俊朗的面容上，往日里常有的轻狂不羁与邪气笑意，在这一瞬间褪得干干净净。
他后退半步，退出一个不会惊扰她的界限，但那双眼眸却如淬了火的利刃，毫不避讳地直直刺进柳师师盈满水光的眼底，只剩下一片深不见底、令人根本无从招架的凝重与赤诚。
我的意思是，“我现下的修为已经足够自保应变，不需要再用那种竭泽而渔的法子，去抽干你的本源了。”
他的视线顺着她憔悴黯淡的脸颊一点点往下落，最终死死盯在她交叠于膝头、正下意识攥紧的双手上。那曾是一双能够拨弄大道玄音、一剑霜寒十四州的绝世玉手。
曾几何时，莹润如极品羊脂，引得无数天骄心生神往。可眼下，因为整整半月不分昼夜、近乎自毁的真元渡让，那十根修长的指骨正不受控制地细微痉挛着。指端褪尽了颜色，只剩下生机枯竭的惨烈青白。
盯着那双伤痕累累的手，陆长生的喉结艰涩地滚了滚。再开口时，他的嗓音已不可抑制地沙哑紧绷，透着化不开的沉痛。“况且……为了成全我，你搭进去的，实在太多了。”
可偏偏就是这句没有几分重量的话，落入柳师师耳中，却不亚于九天玄雷直劈而下，携着万钧之势，将她那颗在半月抵死缠绵中早已千疮百孔的心，砸得稀碎。
幽闭的石室彻底陷入死寂，唯留灵草燃烧的细微声响。
柳师师仰起那张毫无血色的脸，怔怔地看着他。那双常年冰封、被世人敬畏为古井无波的眼瞳深处，正有什么坚不可摧的东西在剧烈发抖、龟裂，直至彻底粉碎。
她死咬着牙关苦守了半个月的傲骨，哪怕在榻上被折腾到神识溃散、气血衰败至油尽灯枯也不肯低头的最后防线，就在这轻飘飘的几个字面前，摧枯拉朽般轰然倒塌，碎成一地拼凑不齐的残渣。
她微微张开起皮的干裂唇瓣，本能地想要竖起全身的尖刺，用最刻薄冷酷的词汇去反击他，想讥讽他猫哭耗子假慈悲，嘲笑他占尽便宜还要立牌坊。
可她悲哀而绝望地发现，自己的喉间像被塞进了一团吸满冰水的粗糙麻核，堵得连一丝缝隙都不剩。酸涩刺痛的感觉一路直逼鼻腔，让她连半个讥嘲的音节都发不出来。

Listening to her shameful and angry accusation, a low and muffled laugh finally escaped from Lu Changsheng's throat. The vibration in the chest broke the stagnant air between the two of them, and even the dark atmosphere around them became tinged with a scorching temperature.
Liu Shishi's thin back couldn't help but feel stiff. She originally thought that the traitor was going to take advantage of the situation like before, and subconsciously curled up like a frightened bird.
Lu Changsheng did not take advantage of the situation to attack the city. Instead, he leaned forward slightly, and with an undeniable but extremely restrained patience, his arms went around her side and pulled the half-undressed skirt of her shoulders closer.
There was silence in the depths of the secret room, except for the spiritual stone wick embedded in the wall that occasionally exploded into a star of blue fireworks, making a faint beeping sound.
The faint bitter medicinal fragrance intertwined with her unique cold plum breath, which was infinitely amplified in the cramped space. Liu Shishi's breathing was rapid and disordered, but the man's breath that brushed against her ear was deep, long, and frighteningly hot.
His fingertips were covered with rough calluses left by sword practice, and they brushed against her delicate collarbone.
The dark and light red marks left by last night's absurdity were vaguely discernible, falling on her current sick body, showing an almost tragic feeling of fragmentation.
Lu Changsheng's movements paused imperceptibly on those delicate marks, and his rough fingertips brought out a touch of extremely secret pity, and gently rubbed them.
This gentleness like peeling off a cocoon is far more terrifying than the plundering of the storm. Liu Shishi felt that wherever her fingertips passed by, it was like being ignited by a branding iron. A burning trembling sensation spread along the fragile meridians, making her heart tremble.
Since the master understands the disciple's thoughts so clearly, including those shady and dirty thoughts, it is really a blessing for the disciple.
But... his tone paused slightly, his slightly cool lips brushed against the most sensitive skin on her neck, and his hot breath swept over her heart like a soft brush. "Not now. I just held you down and prevented you from taking off your clothes. It really wasn't the dirty intention that Master thought."
He sneered very softly, with a hint of deliberate amusement at the end.
"It's you who thinks too much."
These three fluttering words are like a stone dropped into a deep pool of stagnant water. Liu Shishi was completely frozen on the couch, and his pair of peach blossom eyes, which had always been cold and proud, suddenly lost focus at this moment, and the shock and confusion were intertwined and turned into a layer of hazy water vapor.
She leaned against the mattress almost sluggishly, as if her whole body had been stripped away, and she could only let her exhausted body sink deeply into the soft brocade quilt.
She looked at the uncharacteristic man in front of her in disbelief.
But now, this violent traitor lowered his deep and affectionate eyebrows, arranging her clothes in an extremely meticulous, even worshipful manner.
His slender fingers interspersed dexterously, retying the ribbon that she had almost torn off in anger and tying it into a tight knot.
This kind of unexpected contrast is more deadly than the robbery when he is crazy. She has long been accustomed to using a cold mask to withstand his strong oppression, but now this unexpected mercy has turned into a soft knife that kills without blood, chipping away at the hard shell she used to maintain her dignity.
So...what do you want to do? Her lips were so dry that they turned white, and she mumbled out tiny words. Even she herself didn't notice that in the past, she was aloof and accustomed to the tone of stern admonishment, but now she was infected with panic that even she was ashamed to face.
It wasn't until the last fold of clothes was smoothed that Lu Changsheng slowly straightened up. On his handsome face, the frivolous and evil smile that he usually had in the past completely faded away in this moment.
He took half a step back, withdrawing to a limit that would not disturb her, but those eyes were like tempered sharp blades, piercing straight into Liu Shishi's watery eyes without hesitation, leaving only a deepThe solemnity and sincerity that is bottomless and unstoppable.
What I mean is, "My current cultivation level is enough to protect myself and adapt to changes. I don't need to use the method of fishing for the best to drain your essence."
His eyes went down a little bit along her haggard and dull cheeks, and finally stared at her hands folded in her knees and clenched subconsciously. Those were once a pair of peerless jade hands that could manipulate the mysterious sounds of the great avenue and wield the frosty fourteen states with one sword.
Once upon a time, it was as shiny and smooth as the finest mutton fat, attracting countless geniuses to be fascinated by it. But right now, due to the nearly self-destructive transfer of true energy that occurred day and night for half a month, the ten slender finger bones were spasming uncontrollably. The color of the fingertips had faded away, leaving only a tragic bluish-white color that had been drained of vitality.
Staring at those scarred hands, Lu Changsheng's Adam's apple rolled hard. When he spoke again, his voice was uncontrollably hoarse and tight, revealing an indescribable pain. "Besides...in order to fulfill me, you helped me too much."
But these words, which were of little weight, fell into Liu Shishi's ears, but they were no less than the Nine Heavens Mysterious Thunder striking straight down, carrying a huge force, smashing her heart that was already riddled with holes in Half Moon's lingering love, to pieces.
The claustrophobic stone room fell into complete silence, except for the faint sound of burning spiritual grass.
Master Liu raised his bloodless face and looked at him blankly. Deep in those eyes that have been frozen all year round and are revered by the world as ancient wells without waves, something indestructible is trembling violently, cracking, and finally shattering.
She gritted her teeth and held on to her pride for half a month. She was the last line of defense that refused to bow her head even though she was tortured on the couch until her consciousness collapsed and her vitality and blood declined to the point where all the oil and lamp ran out. Just in front of these fluttering words, it collapsed like a torrent and shattered into pieces of debris on the ground.
She slightly opened her peeled, chapped lips, and instinctively wanted to raise the spikes all over her body, and use the harshest and coldest words to fight back against him. She wanted to ridicule him for being a cat crying like a mouse for pretending to be compassionate, and to laugh at him for taking advantage of him and erecting a memorial arch.
But she sadly and desperately found that her throat seemed to have been stuffed with a rough hemp core filled with ice water, blocking not even a single gap. The sour and stinging feeling went all the way to her nasal cavity, making it impossible for her to utter even half a sarcastic syllable.
